title: Realization of continuous scalar cocycles
statement: Let $K$ be a field, $S=K^{sep}$, and $G=\operatorname{Aut}_K(S)$ with its Krull topology. Let $c:G\times G\to S^\times$ be jointly locally constant and satisfy $c(g,h)c(gh,k)=g(c(h,k))c(g,hk)$ for all $g,h,k\in G$. Then there exists a homogeneous continuous degree-two cycle $z$ for the discrete units representation [def-sc-galois-units-cohomology] such that $c_z(g,h)=c(g,h)$ for every $g,h$, with evaluation $c_z(g,h)=z(1,g,gh)$ as in [def-sc-brauer-scalar-defect].

proof.text: Give the coefficient group its defining discrete topology. Joint continuity of the Galois action follows from continuous_prod_of_discrete_right and stabilizer_isOpen_of_isIntegral. Convert the scalar cocycle to an additive continuous cochain; use Units.ext on the field-valued identity and additive cancellation to obtain the additive differential equation.

For an abstract locally compact topological group and a topological representation with jointly continuous action, construct F(a,b,d) = rho(a)(ca(a^-1*b,b^-1*d)). Curry twice, and verify invariance using the representation multiplication law. Expand homogeneousCochains.d_apply in degree two; apply rho(a) to the inhomogeneous cocycle equation to prove the differential is zero. All constructions and verifications are local in the proof, with no new statements or holes.

Apply KernelFork.mapIsoOfIsLimit to cyclesIsKernel and TopModuleCat.isLimitKer. The inverse carries the constructed closed cochain to a cycle; mapOfIsLimit_ι proves its inclusion is the constructed cochain. Evaluation at (1,g,g*h) cancels the group coordinates and yields the original scalar cocycle.
